title: High-Speed Multi-Connection Speed Test Engine
message: Upgraded the built-in speed test to 8 parallel isolated TCP download streams (7s) and 6 parallel 16 MB upload streams (6s) with warm keep-alive ping/jitter, 1.5s slow-start warmup discard, Ookla/Fast.com steady-state trimming, and a 0–1000+ Mbps gauge curve.
